title: The Discharge Argument and the Basement Sanctuary
summary: On Friday, February 13, 2015—one week after his heart attack and four days after open-heart CABG surgery—Jordan is discharged from Star City General Hospital. After weighing the sternal risks of Bennett Hall's heavy doors and shared six-person bed before his power chair arrives, Jordan makes the executive decision to spend his initial recovery week in the Brooks basement in Christiansburg under the One-Bedmate Rule.

scenes.title: Sternal Precautions and the Recovery Protocol
